name: Fantastic Space
source:
The search for a mysterious mineral leads you onto the board of an exploration ship, Odyssey.

With a bit quirky, but still amazing crew by your side, you will find more than you ever expected…

[From official site]
translation:
为了寻找一种神秘矿物，你登上了“奥德赛号”探险船。

在这群有些古怪、却依然出色的船员陪伴下，你将发现远超预期的事物……

[摘自官方网站]
